name: Lono Fontaine
original_name: ロノ・フォンティーヌ
source:
Lono is the butler in charge of cooking. He’s diligent and thorough in his work (as an Executive Chef). And even though he’s not aware of it, he’s good at taking care of others too.

[Translated from [url=https://akunekoring.tumblr.com/post/639945176412979200/character-introduction-pv-lono-fontaine]official character PV[/url]]
